providerCommits: atomic simulated reservation + action + booked trip; uncertain responses reconciled by action ID

integration.claude: real API with captured iMessage transport
integration.photon: live selection, approval and repeated approval confirmed by user
integration.calendar: real integration retained; controlled fixtures verify revoked/read failure guards
integration.phase3Regression: five end-to-end groups passed after shared calendar extraction

databaseSecurity.advisors: INFO only; backend-only tables intentionally have no browser policies

scope.payment: fictional saved Demo Visa label, no real card collection
scope.provider: atomic persisted simulation, not a live airline or payment provider

conversation.defaultReply: 1–3 words for simple acknowledgments and yes/no questions; otherwise usually 3–12 words
conversation.firstRecommendation: one displayed choice by default, under 45 words in tests
conversation.followups: changed legs and price only; no automatic baggage or rejected-fare recap
conversation.alternatives: requested options only; nearby airport comparison avoids duplicate flight times
conversation.verified: real Claude and Supabase, captured iMessage transport; questions before and after booking, restart selection, owner isolation and uncertain delivery
conversation.binaryFlightQuestions: one-word answers verified against owner-bound offer or saved reservation; qualified/compound questions use normal explanation
conversation.approvalRecovery: intervening failure re-presents exact review; a fresh separate approval is still required
conversation.punctuation: no sentence-ending full stops in routine replies; exact persisted reviews stay verbatim
